newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria raises Nov crude prices by 25-35 cents.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria raises Nov crude prices by 25-35 cents.

text.p: Nigerian raised the November prices of its crude oil by between 25 and 35 cents a barrel, traders said on Tuesday.
Bonny Light and Qua Iboe were raised by 27 cents to Dated Brent +63 cents a barrel while Forcados was raised by 34 cents to Dated Brent +70 cents.
Bonny Medium rose by 35 cents to Dated Brent +63 cents while Brass River added 25 cents to Dated +63 cents.
Escravos was raised by 28 cents to Dated Brent +60 cents while Pnnington gained 31 cents to Dated +95 cents.
Nigeria National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) also raised the premium payable for deferred pricing by one cent to 10 cents.
Traders said the price rises were in line with strong demand for November barrels of Nigerian crude from Asian, European and U.S. refiners.
